_meta.title: Fatal police shootings in the United States, 2015-2024 (Washington Post 'Fatal Force' database)
_meta.what: One record per person shot and killed by an on-duty police officer in the United States, as tracked by The Washington Post since 1 January 2015. The Post counts only shootings in which an officer, in the line of duty, shoots and kills a civilian; it does not count deaths in police custody, shootings by off-duty officers, or deaths not caused by shooting. In 2024 the Post said it would only track killings from 2015 to 2024. Earliest record 2015-01-02; latest record 2024-12-31. Race codes decoded per WaPo's v2 README (W White, B Black, A Asian heritage, N Native American, H Hispanic, O Other); blank race shown as 'Unknown'. Coordinates are WaPo's own geocodes; 'precision' restates WaPo's location_precision field. Records without coordinates are kept with null lat/lon.
_meta.source: The Washington Post, Fatal Force database (v2: fatal-police-shootings-data.csv and fatal-police-shootings-agencies.csv)
_meta.attribution: Data: The Washington Post, Fatal Force database (github.com/washingtonpost/data-police-shootings), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Repo wording: 'The data is published under an Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license.'
